description: Currency exchange rates (forex): official ECB reference rates for about 30 currencies (USD, GBP, CHF, JPY, CNY, ...), published every working day around 16:00 CET, cross rates for any base among them. Returns rates object mapping currency codes to rates relative to base. Pass symbols array to filter (e.g. ['USD','CHF','GBP']). Empty symbols = all supported currencies. Use for currency conversion in invoices, pricing, or financial calculations. Price: $0.0045 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"base":"EUR","symbols":["USD","CHF","GBP"]}.

symbols.description: Target currencies to return. Empty = all.
